definitions.explanation: The hospital department that takes X-rays, CT and MRI images, and delivers radiation therapy. One of the department names on a Japanese hospital's floor guide.

examples.japanese: {放射線科|ほうしゃせんか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二階|にかい}→二階：27513_nikai⟧です。
examples.english: The radiology department is on the second floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{放射線科|ほうしゃせんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}された→回す：01158_mawasu⟧。
examples.english: I was sent to the radiology department for an examination.

examples.japanese: {放射線科|ほうしゃせんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: A radiologist looks at the images and judges whether surgery is necessary.

notes:
The suffix {科|か} names a hospital department or an academic subject, as in ⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧ and ⟦{外科|げか}→外科：03983_geka⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {放射線科|ほうしゃせんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the radiology department
- {放射線科|ほうしゃせんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧: a radiologist
- ⟦{放射線|ほうしゃせん}→放射線：14998_houshasen⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: radiation therapy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧: internal medicine — the department for non-surgical treatment
- ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧{科|か}: clinical laboratory department — blood and tissue tests rather than imaging
